hero.title: Product Manager with 4+ years across B2B SaaS, Fintech, and digital products.
hero.summary: Combining end-to-end product ownership with hands-on AI-assisted execution, from discovery and requirements through integrations, prototyping, and delivery.

quickFacts.label: B2B, B2C, SaaS, Fintech, and digital & Mobile platforms

items.title: End-to-End Product Leadership
items.body: Leading products from discovery, customer analysis, and requirement definition through execution, launch, and continuous improvement.

items.title: Complex Integrations and Operations
items.body: Planning and delivering API, ERP, government, and vendor integrations while aligning business, operational, and technical stakeholders.

items.title: AI-Assisted Execution
items.body: Using AI tools to speed up research, prototyping, product workflows, and lightweight implementation in fast-moving environments.

items.summary: Led a financial platform and ERP from pre-launch through MVP, with rapid execution across product, operations, vendors, and integrations.
highlights: Led a financial platform and ERP from pre-launch through MVP in a fast-moving startup environment.
Owned roadmap updates, prioritization, and product requirements in response to strategic shifts and aggressive targets.
Managed strategic vendors across core systems and digital delivery while maintaining quality and execution speed.
Led integrations with external financial API providers and government services, and defined scalable cross-functional solutions.
Integrated AI workflows into day-to-day product operations, reporting, and prototyping to improve efficiency.
Delivered rapid prototypes and feature flows with AI-assisted tools, contributing to about 20% faster team delivery.

items.summary: Software development company delivering fintech and digital products for B2B and B2C clients.
highlights: Managed end-to-end delivery of Web, Mobile, and Fintech products for B2B and B2C clients.
Led product work from discovery and customer analysis through requirements, execution, launch, and customer satisfaction.
Planned and led complex integrations with ERP systems, government services, and external APIs.
Worked closely with design and engineering teams to expand existing products and shape new client-aligned solutions.
Coordinated delivery in a Scrum of Scrums environment, including feature prioritization, roadmap planning, and sprint packaging.
Worked across key domains and clients including Menora Mivtachim, ERN, Bar-Ilan University, Paamonim, and Funjoy.
Led a cross-functional team of 6 across engineering, design, and QA.
Took the product from concept to MVP launch within 6 months, reaching the first user during that period.
Conducted market research and customer validation to shape product direction and priorities.
Defined technical specifications, UX flows, database structure, and system architecture.
Led a team of 4 through the product build.
Built the product from scratch as an organizational information system.
Defined requirements and designed a large, complex database.

items.summary: EdTech ERP and SaaS solutions for education organizations.
highlights: Produced technical specifications for ERP modules and workflows.
Analyzed business processes to define structured requirements for development teams.
Worked on integrated hardware-software and IoT security projects connected to the central ERP system.
